# Phil's Magic Cleaning

> Janitorial, commercial, and window cleaning for homes and businesses on the Peninsula, from South San Francisco to Mountain View, California. Based in Burlingame, CA 94010. Free estimates. Phone (650) 660-0430. Monday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Closed Sunday.

## Book

- [How to book](https://philsmagicclean.com/book): request a free estimate online or call (650) 660-0430. Work is confirmed once the quote and the schedule are agreed.
- [Request a janitorial estimate](https://clienthub.getjobber.com/hubs/c080b44c-658d-4e03-aad4-23bd241272cb/public/requests/5126135/new): commercial and janitorial cleaning.
- [Request window cleaning or other services](https://clienthub.getjobber.com/hubs/c080b44c-658d-4e03-aad4-23bd241272cb/public/requests/5008849/new): window cleaning and other services.

## Services

- [Commercial and janitorial cleaning](https://philsmagicclean.com/janitorial-cleaning): offices, restaurants, storefronts, medical and dental offices, salons, gyms, and other commercial properties; one-time or recurring.
- [Window cleaning](https://philsmagicclean.com/window-cleaning): residential and commercial; starts at $20 per pane.
- [All services](https://philsmagicclean.com/services)
- [Service areas](https://philsmagicclean.com/service-areas): South San Francisco, San Bruno, Millbrae, Burlingame, San Mateo, Foster City, Belmont, San Carlos, Redwood City, Atherton, Menlo Park, East Palo Alto, Palo Alto, Mountain View.
